hooks.name: Confirm destructive AWS commands
hooks.description: Asks the person before any command that deletes demo AWS resources, force-resets git or pushes, as the AI-DLC gate rules require.

action.command: input=$(cat); if printf '%s' "$input" | grep -Eq 'cdk destroy|cloudformation delete-stack|dynamodb delete-table|secretsmanager delete-secret|s3 rb |s3 rm |git push|git reset --hard'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"This command deletes AWS resources, rewrites git history or pushes code. Confirm before it runs."}}'; fi; exit 0
